hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.subtitle: Find answers to the questions our candidates ask most often.

items.question: How do I edit my personal information?
items.answer: Go to the Profile tab and tap “Edit” to update your occupation, city, or other details.

items.question: Can I add another language?
items.answer: Yes. During the “Language skills” step of profile creation, use the “Add another language” selector to extend the list beyond German, English, and French.

items.question: Which documents do I need to provide?
items.answer: A CV, a copy of your passport, and your diplomas are required. You can upload them from the Documents tab.

items.question: How long does document verification take?
items.answer: Our team usually verifies your documents within 48 to 72 business hours.

items.question: Is the language test mandatory?
items.answer: It isn't mandatory, but it's strongly recommended: it builds German employers' confidence in your profile.

items.question: How do I access the German lessons?
items.answer: From the home screen, the “German lessons” section offers free daily lessons.

items.question: Who helps me with the visa and departure?
items.answer: An Amud Skills advisor contacts you as soon as an employer confirms your recruitment, to support you through the administrative steps and your departure.
